members.title: Members
members.intro: Owners and managers manage members. Only owners and admins grant or take the owner role; the project always keeps at least one owner.
members.removeDescription: They will no longer see the project. Their tasks in this project are then assigned to nobody.

danger.title: Delete project
danger.description: Deletes the project with all milestones, todos, tasks and comments.
danger.confirmDescription: All milestones, todos, tasks and comments of this project are deleted. This cannot be undone.

error.unavailable: The server cannot be reached right now.

apiError.unauthorized: You are not allowed to do this.
apiError.csrf: Your session had expired. Please try again.

challenge.title: Second factor
challenge.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
challenge.recoveryHint: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each works only once.
challenge.useCode: Use the code from the app

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: We will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If we know this address, the link is on its way. It is valid for 60 minutes.

setPassword.invalidLink: The link is incomplete. Please open it again from the email.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. Sign in with it now.

invitation.title: Accept invitation
invitation.description: Welcome! Choose a password for your account.
invitation.done: Your account is ready. Sign in now.

setup.title: Secure your account
setup.description: Before you start, secure your account with a second factor.

projects.title: Projects
projects.noneMember: As soon as someone adds you to a project, it appears here.
projects.notFound: This project does not exist, or you have no access.

fields.name: Name
fields.localeHint: Notifications about this project are sent in this language.

project.noMilestonesHint: Create the first milestone, for example “Design approved”.

fields.title: Title
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: What does it involve? Lists, links and emphasis are possible.

milestone.deleteDescription: “{title}” is deleted with all its todos, tasks and comments. This cannot be undone.

todo.deleteDescription: “{title}” is deleted with all its tasks and comments. This cannot be undone.

link.invalid: Only links with http://, https:// or mailto: are possible.

task.notFound: This task does not exist, or you have no access.
task.assignedMail: They get an email if they receive notifications.
task.deleteDescription: “{title}” is deleted with all its comments. This cannot be undone.

comments.title: Comments ({count})
comments.deleteDescription: The comment is deleted for good.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.hint: JPG or PNG, at most 5 MB. The picture is cropped to a square.
avatar.type: Only JPG or PNG pictures are possible.
avatar.size: The picture is larger than 5 MB.

notifications.label: Email notifications
notifications.description: Emails about new assignments and comments on your tasks.

security.title: Security
security.required: To sign in you need a second factor besides your password: an authenticator app or a passkey.
security.optional: Two-factor authentication is currently switched off for this app. You can still set up a second factor.
security.lastFactor: It is your last second factor: you will have to set up a new one right away.

confirmPassword.title: Confirm password
confirmPassword.description: Please confirm your password before changing the security of your account.

twoFactor.title: Authenticator app
twoFactor.intro: With an app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password you create a 6-digit code at every sign-in.
twoFactor.scan: Scan the QR code with your app, then enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.manual: Without a camera: enter this key in the app:
twoFactor.enabled: The authenticator app is set up.

recovery.keepSafe: Keep these recovery codes safe. Each replaces the code from the app once, for example when the phone is lost.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: With a passkey you sign in without a code, using your device's fingerprint, face recognition or PIN. Best set up two, for example on laptop and phone.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.exists: This device already has a passkey for your account.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.secondHint: Tip: set up a second passkey or the authenticator app in case this device gets lost.

users.title: Users
users.inviteHint: They get an email with a link to set their password (valid 7 days). Afterwards they set up a second factor.
users.isAdminHint: Admins see all projects and manage users.
users.ownAdmin: You cannot remove your own admin role.
users.resetDescription: Removes the authenticator app and all passkeys and signs them out everywhere, for example after a lost device. At the next sign-in they set up a new second factor.
users.avatarDescription: For example an unsuitable picture. They can upload a new one afterwards.
users.deleteDescription: The account is deleted. Comments stay without a name, assigned tasks are then assigned to nobody.

settings.title: App settings
settings.twoFactorDescription: When on, every sign-in also needs an authenticator app or a passkey. When off, the password is enough.
settings.twoFactorOff: 2FA is off: the password is enough.
settings.notSwitchable: On the production server 2FA is always required and cannot be switched off.
settings.offWarning: 2FA is switched off. This is meant for testing only.

claude.title: Access for Claude
claude.intro: With a personal access token, Claude (for example Claude Code) can read projects and fill them with milestones, todos and tasks, with your permissions. Claude cannot delete anything. A token is valid for 90 days.
claude.name: Name
claude.nameHint: To recognise it, for example “Claude laptop”
claude.showOnce: Copy the token now. It is shown only this once.
claude.commandHint: Run it in a terminal; afterwards Claude Code knows the server “projektverwaltung”.
claude.revokeDescription: Claude can no longer use this token afterwards.

chat.title: Chat
chat.emptyDescription: Who takes part, what should come out of it, by when? Claude drafts milestones, todos and tasks from it. Nothing is saved until “Create now”.
chat.placeholder: Message to the assistant (Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line)
chat.thinking: Claude is drafting the plan … this can take a minute.
chat.planReady: The draft is in the preview.
chat.voiceHint: Voice input: the browser sends the recording to its provider for recognition (Google in Chrome, Microsoft in Edge).
chat.voiceError: Voice input not possible ({error}). Is the microphone allowed?

preview.title: Preview
preview.notifyHint: Everyone gets one mail per assigned task.
preview.emptyDescription: As soon as you describe your project in the chat, the plan appears here: name, description and the timeline with milestones, todos and tasks.
